## Checklist
- [ ] `ruff check .` and `python -m pytest --cov` pass (coverage ≥ 95%)
- [ ] No safety lock loosened; stop still always succeeds; sensors can still only dim or stop
- [ ] Unknown fields are still refused (`extra="forbid"`)
- [ ] If outputs changed: regenerated `examples/demo/` with `python -m spark_iis demo` and explained the change
- [ ] Every new number is tagged SYNTHETIC / REPORTED / TARGET / UNRUN
- [ ] No therapeutic, neurological, "coherence", HBOT-synergy or quantum claim; no medical-device integration; no hardware driver
- [ ] No real participant data, names, contact details or health records
- [ ] README and CHANGELOG updated
